h:
专为初学者打造的强大工作流程，具有面部、身体和胸部区域的分段放大功能、对风格或构图克隆的 IP 适配器支持、OpenPose 控制网络等。
在构建时考虑了简化的结构和布局，以帮助新用户了解更高级的功能，例如控制网和 SAM 探测器。”


注意：此工作流程中有很多自定义节点，我相信其中大多数是每个人都应该拥有的核心自定义节点，尽管我确实意识到很多人会不喜欢/为此苦苦挣扎，所以请在使用此工作流程之前记住这一点。

注：这是我公开的第一个工作流程，请提供建设性的反馈！

o.en:
A powerful workflow built for beginners featuring segmented upscaling of face, body and chest areas, IP-Adapter support for style or composition cloning, OpenPose controlnet and more.
Built with simplified structure and layout in mind to help educate newer users on more advanced functions such as controlnets and SAM detectors."


NOTE: There are a LOT of custom nodes in this workflow, most of which i believe are core custom nodes everyone should have, though I do realize a lot of you will dislike/struggle with this, so please keep this in mind before using this workflow.

Note: This is my first workflow i am making public, please provide constructive feedback!
